title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rodney Thomas II signs with Seahawks active roster
items.desc: The Seahawks are signing safety Rodney Thomas II off their practice squad to their 53-man roster.
items.impact: Thomas has started the first two games with Ty Okada hurt. He had one more practice squad elevation.

items.title: Austin Johnson signs with Bills
items.desc: The Bills signed DL Austin Johnson to the team's practice squad.
items.impact: Johnson will add depth on the defensive line for Buffalo.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ed Oliver (hip) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ed Oliver (hip) missed Buffalo's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Oliver suffered this hip injury in pregame warmups last week. He was still sidelined at practice on Wednesday, and it looks like it may force him to miss another week. His absence this weekend would be less than ideal for the Bills ahead of a competitive matchup against the Chargers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ty Johnson (hamstring) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Ty Johnson (hamstring) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran running back seems very close to a return to the field, as he was able to practice in full on Wednesday after being sidelined for last week's game. He is trending towards playing in Week 3, but his potential return would be unlikely to have a substantial impact on Buffalo's backfield moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keon Coleman (ankle) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Keon Coleman (ankle) did not take part in Buffalo's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The young wideout is now recovering from an ankle injury and may miss Sunday's game because of it. If he is ruled out ahead of game time, look for Khalil Shakir and Dalton Kincaid to be two of the main beneficiaries of his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: DJ Moore (shoulder) was officially limited in Buffalo's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Moore suffered a shoulder injury during last week's win over the Lions. He is considered day-to-day for now and was able to practice on Wednesday in a limited fashion. He may be ready to play in time for Week 3, but we likely won't know his official status until the end of the practice week on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Alaric Jackson (knee) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Alaric Jackson (knee) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Los Angeles' starting left tackle is dealing with an injury right now. Alaric was limited at Wednesday's walk-through due to a knee issue, but it's still early in the week and he may very well be cleared to play prior to Week 3. His potential absence would be bad news for the Rams ahead of a tough matchup against Denver's elite defensive front, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Ferguson was estimated to be a limited participant at Wednesday's walk-through for the Rams. He's managing an ankle injury right now, but it doesn't seem to be more than a minor issue for him at this point. Fantasy managers should keep tabs on updates about his health and about the health of Puka Nacua (hip), as the young tight end benefited greatly when Los Angeles was missing their star wideout last week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Colby Parkinson (knee) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Colby Parkinson (knee) missed Los Angeles' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was held out of practice due to a knee injury on Wednesday. We won't know if there's much substance to this injury until later on in the week, but Terrance Ferguson (ankle) will see more work if Parkinson has to miss any time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kamren Kinchens (hamstring) a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Kamren Kinchens (hamstring) was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Kinchens was not able to partake in Wednesday's walk-through due to a hamstring issue. If it forces him to miss time, Los Angeles' secondary will look weaker than usual in a matchup against the Broncos this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Puka Nacua (hip) officially doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Puka Nacua (hip) officially did not take part in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: As expected, Nacua was not able to practice for the Rams on Wednesday and was officially sidelined. He remains uncertain for Week 3, but it sounds like the team is looking to err on the side of caution if it comes down to the wire, which would again lead to more work for Davante Adams and Terrance Ferguson (ankle) on Sunday night.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Demarcus Robinson (ankle) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Demarcus Robinson (ankle) was absent from Los Angeles' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Robinson wasn't able to practice on Wednesday, which comes as no surprise considering that the 49ers are contemplating whether or not to place him on injured reserve. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to play a role on this offense for the next couple of weeks at least.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian McCaffrey (rest) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey (rest) did not take part in San Francisco's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: McCaffrey was given Wednesday off as a veteran rest day, which is normal for him at the first practice of the week. He should be a full go for Sunday's game and remains a must-start fantasy option in all league formats for as long as he stays healthy and on the field.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylin Lane (groin) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Jaylin Lane (groin) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The young wideout is still listed on Washington's injury report due to a nagging groin issue, but he was able to play through it last week and should be able to do the same again in Week 3. He isn't expected to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, however.
